_what: A search for a tool that finds nothing is kept in the person's own records (src/dead-end-search.mjs), beside the tool choices and dropped by the same sweep (src/tool-choice-keep.json keep_days). `name_prefix` is the record name family (it stays inside choice:tool: so the choice keep's index and sweep cover it); a job shorter than `min_characters` or listed in `ignore` is not kept; a job is cut to `most_job_characters`. `words.asked_before` is what an empty answer says when the same job was asked for before.

words.asked_before: This job was searched for {times} times before and found nothing; the first time was {first_at}.
